1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __wherein the agitating is performed for a predetermined time period followed by transferring a portion of the medium containing the shed cellular material to a separate container__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the agitating is performed using mechanical agitation__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __wherein the cold exposure comprises incubation at 4°C__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __wherein the heating comprises incubation at 95°C__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least twice__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from the group consisting of cellulase, pectinase, and hemicellulase__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a commercial DNA extraction kit__.

10. (Original) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __that are less than 20 days after pollination__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __wherein the storing comprises maintaining the embryos in a controlled environment__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __for trait-associated genetic markers__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

16. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __wherein the selecting is performed prior to germination of the embryos__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __wherein the germinating occurs after the selecting step__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using robotic handling equipment__.
